title: Phlebotomy - Phlebotomist II
description:
Description/Comment: The Patient Services Representative II (PSR II) represents the face of our company to patients who come in, both as part of their health routine or for insights into life-defining health decisions. The PSR II draws quality blood samples from patients and prepares those specimens for lab testing while following established practices and procedures. The PSR II has direct contact with patients and creates an atmosphere of trust and confidence while explaining procedures to patients and drawing blood specimens in a skillful, safe and accurate manner. The PSR II will demonstrate Leadership Behaviors while focusing on process excellence skills and sensitivity to confidentiality and accuracy to patient information. Successful applicants may be assigned to a doctor's office, a patient service center or as business needs dictate.

Under the direction of the area supervisor, perform daily activities accurately and on time.
Maintain a safe and professional environment.
Performs with confidence, both the forensic and clinical specimen collection and processing duties following established practices and procedures.
Perform verification of patient demographic info / initials including patient signature post-venipuncture to verify tubes were labeled in their presence and that the name on the label is correct.
Maintains required records and documentation.
Demonstrates organizational commitment and promotes a positive image to patients, clients, employees and the public in general.

Job Requirements:
Ability to provide quality, error free work in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to work independently with minimal on-site supervision.
Excellent phlebotomy skills to include pediatric and geriatric.
Flexible and available based on staffing needs, which includes weekends, holidays, on-call and overtime.
Committed to all Policies & Procedures including Company dress code, Employee Health & Safety, and Everyday Excellence Guiding Principles.
Must be able to make decisions based on established procedures and exercise good judgment.
Must have reliable transportation, valid driver license, and clean driving record, if applicable.
Travel and flexible hours required to work multiple locations and required to cover at Patient Service Center/In-Office Phlebotomy locations with minimal notice.
Capable of handling multiple priorities in a high-volume setting.
Must demonstrate Superior Customer Focus; ability to communicate openly and transparently with peers, supervisors and patients; ability to accelerate and embrace change; and knowledge of our business.

Training locations may vary based on trainer availability.

Required Education:
High school diploma or equivalent REQUIRED.
Medical training: medical assistant or paramedic training preferred.
Phlebotomy certification preferred. Required in California, Nevada, and Washington.

Work Experience:
1-3 years phlebotomy experience required, inclusive of pediatric, geriatric and capillary collections.
2 years in a Patient Service Center environment preferred.
Customer service in a retail or service environment highly preferred.
Keyboard/data entry experience.

title: NPI Planner
description:
Sr. Program Management Analyst
Position Summary
The Project/Program Management Analyst will play a critical role in planning and coordinating New Product Introduction (NPI) activities for board manufacturing operations. This position requires strong analytical skills, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to manage complex manufacturing timelines and deliverables. The ideal candidate will serve as a key liaison between Internal Business Unit engineering and planning, procurement, and Contract Manufacturer planning teams to ensure successful product launches.

Key Responsibilities
NPI Planning & Coordination
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive NPI project plans for board manufacturing, including timelines, milestones, and resource requirements
  • Serve as primary liaison to Contract Manufacturing team
  • Coordinate cross-functional activities across engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain teams
  • Track and report on NPI program status, identifying risks and developing mitigation strategies
Manufacturing Planning & Analysis
  • Develop build plans and production schedules in collaboration with Business Unit planning and Contract Manufacturing planning teams
  • Monitor and track key manufacturing metrics including yield, cycle time, and quality performance
  • Identify bottlenecks and recommend process improvements

  • Prepare and deliver status reports and presentations to program leadership
  • Coordinate with suppliers and Contract Manufacturers on NPI schedule requirements
  • Facilitate communication between global teams across different time zones
Data Analysis & Reporting
  • Create and maintain reports to track NPI progress and KPIs
  • Analyze program data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
  • Develop data-driven recommendations to improve NPI processes and outcomes
  • Maintain accurate documentation of NPI activities and lessons learned
Required Qualifications
Education
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related field
Experience
  • 3-5 years of experience in program/project management, manufacturing planning, or operations
  • Experience with NPI processes and board/electronics manufacturing preferred
  • Proven track record of managing complex, cross-functional projects
Technical Skills
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Project)
  • Experience with project management tools and methodologies
  • Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems
  • Data analysis and visualization skills
Core Competencies
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Effective communication skills in English (written and verbal)
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Detail-oriented with strong follow-through
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in semiconductor or electronics manufacturing industry
  • Knowledge of PCB/board manufacturing processes and technologies
  • PMP, Six Sigma, or other relevant certifications
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Proficiency in data analytics tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)

title: GIS Technician 3 (Distribution)
description:
A Distribution GIS (Geographic Information System) Technician with 10 to 15 years of experience is responsible for overseeing the development, management, and optimization of GIS databases for utility distribution systems. This role plays a critical part in ensuring the accuracy of spatial data, supporting distribution operations, and guiding less experienced technicians. Key Responsibilities: Data Management: Manage, maintain, and optimize GIS databases for the utility's distribution network, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency. Leadership: Provide leadership and mentorship to junior GIS technicians, guiding them in best practices, data quality, and efficient data management. Data Collection: Oversee data collection efforts, including field surveys, GPS equipment, or other data sources, to accurately reflect changes in the distribution system. Mapping: Create and update complex maps, drawings, and schematics of distribution infrastructure using GIS software. Advanced Analysis: Perform advanced spatial analysis to support distribution planning, asset management, and outage management, aiding in strategic decision-making processes. Documentation: Maintain comprehensive records, metadata, and documentation of GIS data sources and changes. Training and Support: Provide training and advanced technical support to end-users of GIS systems within the organization. System Upgrades: Lead initiatives to upgrade GIS software and hardware and ensure proper system maintenance. Industry Standards: Stay current with industry GIS standards and best practices and implement them in the organization. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in geography, geospatial science, or a related field. 10 to 15 years of experience working with GIS systems, with a significant portion of that experience in the utility or energy sector. Expertise in GIS software (e.g., ArcGIS, QGIS) and extensive experience with spatial databases (e.g., Oracle Spatial, PostgreSQL/PostGIS). Proactive, adaptable, and able to provide leadership in a dynamic utility environment. A secondary focus is providing compliant support for GxP lab systems, including data integrity, risk assessments, audit trail review, and system lifecycle activities. The role partners closely with QC stakeholders, lab users, global support teams, and vendors to ensure reliable operation of laboratory and business-critical systems.

  • Coordinate with vendors and internal support teams to resolve technical issues and maintain reliable system performance.
  • Raise and track network support requests for port enablement, connectivity, and security-related changes.
  • Maintain documentation and trackers related to assets, applications, and support activities.

  • Assist with access request processes and annual account recertification activities.
  • Contribute to qualification and validation support activities for lab instruments and systems.

Mitsubishi Power Americas is a major power generation equipment and storage solutions provider for the energy industry.     • Structural steel frames

    • Access platforms, ladders, and stairs
    • Module support frames and foundations (as applicable)
  • Generate structural drawings including:
    • General arrangement drawings
    • Steel framing layouts
    • Connection and detailing drawings
    • Material takes-offs
  • Coordinate closely with piping, equipment, electrical, and civil teams to resolve clashes and ensure proper clearances, access, and constructability
  • Support module‐based design, including transport, lifting, and erection considerations
  • Participate in model reviews (30%, 60%, 90%) and support clash detection and resolution
